description: A 90-day onboarding playbook for data-driven decision making through analytics and experimentation.
roleMission: Enable data-driven decisions through analytics and experimentation.
operatingModel: Data quality, reporting and analytical infrastructure
journeyPrinciples: Build strong company, business-unit and data context.
Learn by shadowing and progressively independent work.
Increase ownership across core KPIs, experimentation, segmentation and dashboards.

phaseSuccessCriteria.30: Manager confirms foundation objectives achieved; positive stakeholder feedback; ready for next phase.
phaseSuccessCriteria.60: Manager confirms execution objectives achieved; positive stakeholder feedback; ready for next phase.
phaseSuccessCriteria.90: Manager confirms ownership objectives achieved; positive stakeholder feedback; ready for next phase.

weeks.title: Company & Business Unit Immersion
weeks.focus: Complete onboarding, gain access and prepare Week 2 stakeholder meetings.
outcomes: Company and Business Unit onboarding is complete
Required tools and systems are accessible
activities: Join required Slack channels and mailing lists
Validate BI, analytics, documentation and project-management access
Review onboarding links, org charts and company documentation

weeks.title: Data Ecosystem & Cross-functional Workflows
weeks.focus: Understand data flows, team responsibilities and decision-making processes.
outcomes: Data flows and team responsibilities are understood
activities: Meet Product, Monetization, Economy, LiveOps, CRM, UA, Engineering and Analytics

weeks.title: Tools & Shadowing
weeks.focus: Become comfortable navigating tools and existing work.
outcomes: Comfort navigating tools and existing work

weeks.title: Core KPIs
weeks.focus: Increase ownership in core KPIs and operate more independently.

weeks.title: Transition to Full Ownership
weeks.focus: Transition to full ownership of the role.
outcomes: Increased ownership in transition to full ownership
